title: Made some gluten free pancakes on this awesome griddle. I love it
text:
Made some gluten free pancakes on this awesome griddle. I love it. Made some gluten free pancakes on this awesome griddle. I love it. Pancakes did not stick. Easy to use and easy to clean.

Not 5 stars because it has some tiny bumps on the surface. Didn't have any effect on the cooking. I'm just concerned that it might cause chipping issues in the future.

description: Hamilton Beach Reversible Durathon Ceramic Griddle Plug it in from either side . now that's Good Thinking. Set up your griddle where you want to cook without having to get out an extension cord. With a unique reversible design, the Hamilton Beach Reversible Durathon Ceramic Griddle lets you connect the power cord from either side of the griddle. Made with Durathon ceramic, this griddle provides you with superior nonstick performance. The heat is adjustable for a greater range of cooking options. And you can make a whole meal with little fuss thanks to the large 200 square inch cooking surface. Key Features: • Unique reversible design lets you use cord on either side • Durathon ceramic nonstick coating: o 4 times more durable than traditional nonstick o Won't crack or peel o PTFE & PFOA free • 200 square inch cooking surface • Simply lift off griddle for easy cord reversal and cleaning • Adjustable temperature control - 200O-400O Cord Access on Both Sides The reversible design lets you adjust the cord access to either side of the griddle, so you can plug it in to the most convenient outlet. Durathon Surface Won't Crack or Peel With a nonstick ceramic surface four times more durable than traditional nonstick, you won't have to worry about scraping your meal off the cooking surface. Plus, Durathon is safe and free of PTFE & PFOA. Drip Tray Catches Mess A removable, dishwasher-safe drip tray catches excess grease and other drips, keeping your countertop free of messes. Great for Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner Griddles are commonly used at breakfast because they are perfect for pancakes and fried eggs, but they are flexible enough to be used all day. Try grilled cheese sandwiches for lunch or tender, juicy hamburgers and hotdogs for dinner.
